lead_raw_text:
The structure of Gd2Fe4Si4 (reduced formula Gd(FeSi)2) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe centers with 12 neighbors (4 Fe, 8 Si), Gd centers with 16 neighbors (8 Fe, 8 Si), and two distinct Si environments: one with 9 neighbors (3 Fe, 4 Gd, 2 Si) and one with 10 neighbors (4 Fe, 4 Gd, 2 Si). The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner, edge, and face sharing among Fe, Gd, and Si coordination polyhedra.
